root_cause_analysis: The Instagram Graph API failed to fetch the media file from the provided raw GitHub URL (OAuthException code 9004, subcode 2207052). This typically happens when the image URI does not meet Meta's content/hosting requirements, is publicly inaccessible at the exact moment of the request, or the raw file link is invalid.
actionable_instructions: Verify that the GitHub repository is public and the raw image URLs are directly reachable via a standard HTTP GET request without authentication.
Check if the images were successfully committed and pushed to the remote repository prior to triggering the publishing pipeline.
Consider utilizing a dedicated, highly available CDN or cloud storage bucket (e.g., AWS S3) instead of GitHub raw links to host carousel slides for the Instagram Graph API.
